portfolio.title: PayTrack
portfolio.description:
About PayTrack
PayTrack is a smart invoicing and business management app built for Nigerian small
business owners — tailors, plumbers, electricians, shop owners, and service providers who
need a simple, reliable way to track money coming in and going out, without the complexity
of enterprise accounting software.
Key Features
Professional Invoicing — create, send, and track invoices in seconds. Share any
invoice as a PDF directly to WhatsApp, email, or SMS with one tap.
Customer & Promise Tracking — keep a clean record of every customer and every
"promise to pay," so nothing gets forgotten.
Automatic Payment Reminders — set a due date once, and PayTrack automatically emails
or texts the customer as it approaches — no manual follow-up needed.
Secure Online Payments — accept payments directly through the app via Flutterwave,
Nigeria's trusted payment platform.
Expense Tracking & Real Profit Insight — log business expenses alongside income and
see your actual net profit, not just what customers owe you.
Business Analytics — a simple visual dashboard showing revenue trends, your top
customers, and outstanding overdue amounts at a glance.
Inventory & Stock Tracking — track product stock levels and link them directly to
invoices, so stock updates automatically as you sell.
Business Search — research anything business-related — industry trends, market
info, ideas — right from inside the app.
Kola, Your Business Assistant — a built-in assistant that helps you navigate the
app, create invoices, and manage customers by voice or text.
Bank-Level Account Security — real email verification, secure sign-in with Google or
email, and password recovery built in.
Built for Nigeria — designed around how Nigerian small businesses actually work, from
the ground up.

caseStudies.title: FitPulse Health & Workout Tracker
caseStudies.summary: How Dee-Maker built a cross-platform mobile health tracker with offline sync and live biometric telemetry in 5 weeks.
caseStudies.problem: FitPulse had a web MVP that users couldn't bring to the gym due to poor mobile web UI and lack of offline connectivity when working out in basements or low-reception areas.
caseStudies.approach: Built a native-feel React Native mobile application paired with a local SQLite/AsyncStorage sync queue. Designed custom smooth SVG charting for heart rate zones and simplified workout logging to 2 taps per exercise set.
caseStudies.outcome: Successfully launched on iOS App Store and Google Play Store. Reached over 5,000 active users within 60 days with a 4.9-star rating.

caseStudies.title: SwiftLend Peer-to-Peer Rental Portal
caseStudies.summary: Building an automated tool rental marketplace with Stripe Connect escrow and real-time availability calendar.
caseStudies.problem: Equipment owners and contractors were losing deals due to slow manual email bookings and double-booking conflicts.
caseStudies.approach: Engineered a custom React & Node.js marketplace with Stripe Connect automated payouts, instant identity verification, and conflict-free booking calendar constraints.
caseStudies.outcome: Processed over $120,000 in rental equipment volume during the first 90 days following launch.

caseStudies.title: OmniRoute Fleet Dispatcher
caseStudies.summary: Transitioning a regional logistics company from paper dispatch slips to a sub-second WebSocket dashboard.
caseStudies.problem: Dispatchers were spending 3+ hours daily making phone calls to update driver statuses and route changes.
caseStudies.approach: Created a high-density React control room dashboard connected via WebSockets to driver GPS updates with automated route re-calculation and instant SMS dispatch alerts.
caseStudies.outcome: Reduced fleet dispatch delay by 42% and saved dispatchers an estimated 18 hours per week in manual calls.

testimonials.quote: Dee-Maker took our manual paper-dispatch system and built an intuitive web portal in 5 weeks. Our driver efficiency increased immediately.
Working with Dee-Maker felt like having a co-founder CTO. Clear about timelines, caught edge cases early, and launched our iOS app seamlessly.
Zero fluff, great communication, and pristine code. Dee-Maker is our go-to studio for every major product feature update.

faqs.question: How does your project pricing work?
faqs.answer: We offer fixed-scope milestone quotes for well-defined MVPs and platforms, as well as weekly sprint contracts for ongoing app and web development. Every project includes a detailed scope breakdown before any agreement.

faqs.question: What is your typical project turnaround time?
faqs.answer: A focused MVP app usually takes 3 to 6 weeks from initial wireframes to test builds. Larger platforms with complex backend infrastructure typically take 8 to 12 weeks.

faqs.question: How does the development process work?
faqs.answer:
1. Scope & Design Sync: We finalize core user flows.
2. Weekly Sprints: You get a working test build every Friday.
3. Testing & QA: Rigorous mobile device and browser testing.
4. Handover & Deployment: App Store submission and server deployment with full source code transfer.

faqs.question: Do you assist with App Store and Play Store publishing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle developer account setup, test builds (TestFlight / Internal Testing), production submission, and compliance review assets.
